name: fj
description: Forgejo in a docked pane, for the repo behind the current directory's origin

token.title: Forgejo tokens
token.description: Forgejo or Gitea access tokens, kept in secure storage. A bare token is for every host; more hosts take host=token pairs separated by spaces. A pair wins over a bare token. Needs read:issue, read:repository and read:user; write:issue instead of read:issue lets fj assign and close.

gitlabTokens.title: GitLab tokens
gitlabTokens.description: GitLab access tokens, kept in secure storage, in the same form as Forgejo tokens. Needs api to assign and close, or read_api for read only.

label.title: Epic label
label.description: The label that makes an issue an epic. Its children are the issues it depends on.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Count fj's requests to the forge, on a line under the repo line: the last action's and the session's.

compact.title: Compact
compact.description: Lists without an empty line between rows. ask: fj asks once, after setup.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Buttons as Nerd Font icons, which needs a Nerd Font in the terminal, or as words. ask: fj asks once, after setup.
